rec.name: Section Spacing Controls (Spacing Section + per-section margin/padding)

what.text: Two related spacing tools for a Shopify theme. (1) A standalone 'Spacing Section' that can be dropped between any two sections to add a blank band of vertical space, with its own background color, text color, top/bottom space in px, and separate mobile top/bottom space. (2) Desktop and mobile margin and padding sliders added to every existing section (99 in this theme). Margins can go negative and default to 0, so spacing can be reduced or removed, which the standalone section cannot do.

why.text: Spacing and visual rhythm decide whether page blocks read as one coherent flow or as cramped or disconnected pieces. Fine control over whitespace makes it faster to test layout variants: tighter spacing to pull key content above the fold, or more breathing room to separate offers. This is a utility with no direct conversion mechanism, so the lift comes indirectly from faster, cleaner A/B test builds.

how.text: Spacing Section: create a section with color pickers for background and text, range sliders for top and bottom space (desktop, e.g. 100px), and a 'Mobile settings' group with its own sliders (e.g. 50px), all rendered as padding on a wrapper div. Per-section controls: add a shared spacing snippet or schema block to every section file. It provides 'Desktop spacing' (Top/Bottom Margin, Top/Bottom Padding) and 'Mobile spacing' (the same four fields), output as scoped CSS variables or inline styles. Margin sliders allow negative values and default to 0, and padding defaults match each section's existing spacing so the live layout doesn't change. Set a section's top padding to 0 to close unwanted gaps. Work in a duplicated theme connected to GitHub, then merge to the live theme.

items: Spacing Section: background color (e.g. #F6A429 in the demo)
Spacing Section: text color (can be transparent)
Spacing Section: top space (px) and bottom space (px) on desktop
Spacing Section: top space (mobile) and bottom space (mobile) in px
All sections: desktop Top Margin and Bottom Margin (negative allowed, default 0)
All sections: desktop Top Padding and Bottom Padding (e.g. 64px on Featured collections)
All sections: mobile Top Margin, Bottom Margin, Top Padding and Bottom Padding (e.g. 36px padding on Featured collections)

dependencies.text: Custom Shopify theme (Nordlichtstore, based on theme version 8.11.4) with editable section files and a GitHub-connected theme branch. No apps or metafields. The negative margin and padding schema has to be added to every section file (99 sections, about 4+ hours of dev work). Existing sections' default padding values must be preserved to avoid layout regressions.

items: Conversion rate of the A/B variant that uses layout/spacing changes
Scroll depth and visibility of key blocks (e.g. products above the fold)
Bounce rate on pages where spacing was changed
Dev time to ship a layout test (internal efficiency)

images.caption: Spacing Section in the theme editor: orange spacer band on the homepage, with background, text color, top/bottom space and mobile space settings highlighted.
Featured collections section with new Desktop spacing and Mobile spacing groups (Top/Bottom Margin and Padding sliders in px).
Shop-the-look section with margin/padding controls. Top padding set to 0 closes the gap under the 'Made in Portugal' banner.
